drivingQuestion: Why does the mishna require three for the warning?

segments.he: וּמַתְרִין בִּפְנֵי שְׁלֹשָׁה? לְמָה לִי? בִּתְרֵי סַגְיָא! אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: הָכִי קָאָמַר – מַתְרִין בּוֹ בִּפְנֵי שְׁנַיִם, וּמַלְקִין אוֹתוֹ בִּפְנֵי שְׁלֹשָׁה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that after the rebellious son is brought before the elders of the city, «he is admonished before three» people. The Gemara asks: «Why do I» need him to be admonished before three people? «Two» witnesses should «suffice,» as in all other matters of halakha. «Abaye says: This» is what the mishna «is saying: He is admonished before two» people, who serve as witnesses, «and he is flogged before three» people, who constitute a court.
